title: Everyday Pay Card Statement Cashback Payments, Cartwise Shopper Payouts Desk Reference
content:
# Statement cashback payments on the Everyday Pay Card

On the Everyday Pay Card plans of Cartwise Shopper Payouts (Everyday Pay Card Blue, Gold, Platinum and Diamond), cashback earned on card purchases is paid onto the card by a statement payment. A statement payment falls due when a statement month's payment day has come and the card still holds cashback earned and not yet paid. It is one cashback payment booked on the shopper payout account, labelled with the statement month it carries; the shopper sees it on the card, and the card cashback balance shown on the account falls by the amount paid.

The support agent books a statement payment that is due with the tool `pay_statement_cashback_5d281cc6`. The amount booked is the amount the Everyday Pay Card cashback rules give for that payment; the tool books exactly the amount it is given.

## Tool: `pay_statement_cashback_5d281cc6`

### Situation of use and capability

The tool pays Everyday Pay Card cashback onto the shopper's card as a statement payment. One call books one cashback payment of the stated amount on the shopper payout account, labelled with the statement month it carries, and the card cashback balance shown on the account falls by the same amount, never below zero.

### How it is invoked

The tool is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `pay_statement_cashback_5d281cc6` and then calls it; the shopper does not run it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_account_id` | The shopper payout account number the cashback belongs to, read from the payout account lookup | Identifier, as shown in the lookup |
| `statement_month` | The statement month the payment carries | Year and month written YYYY-MM |
| `amount_usd` | The cashback paid onto the card | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), booked exactly as given with no further rounding |

- `payout_account_id` identifies the account; the payment is booked on that account only.
- `statement_month` is a label in YYYY-MM form, for example 2025-07 in a hypothetical call.
- `amount_usd` is booked as passed; the tool performs no rounding and no calculation of its own.

### Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with:

- `status`: "paid" when the payment was booked;
- `payout_event_id`: the reference number of the cashback payment entry;
- `statement_month`: the month carried, YYYY-MM;
- `amount_usd`: the amount paid, USD with 2 decimal places;
- `event_date`: the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `cashback_balance_usd`: the card cashback balance left, USD with 2 decimal places.

## Hypothetical input and receipt

A hypothetical call with `statement_month` 2025-07 and `amount_usd` 18.40 on an account showing a card cashback balance of 25.00 returns `status` "paid", the new entry's reference number, `statement_month` 2025-07, `amount_usd` 18.40, the booking date and `cashback_balance_usd` 6.60. A payment larger than the balance shown leaves `cashback_balance_usd` at 0.00, since the balance never falls below zero.
